# Choppiness Index

*Choppiness: high when the market ranges, low when it trends.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Choppiness Index** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/chop.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Choppiness Index", shortTitle: "CHOP", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 2 });
const atrSum = ta.sum(ta.atr(1), length), hh = ta.highest(candle.high, length), ll = ta.lowest(candle.low, length);
plot(ta.calc([atrSum, hh, ll], (a, h, l) => (100 * math.log(a / (h - l))) / math.log(length)), { title: "CHOP", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(61.8, { title: "Upper band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
hline(50, { title: "Middle band", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dotted" });
hline(38.2, { title: "Lower band", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
fill(61.8, 38.2, { title: "Background", color: "rgba(33,150,243,0.1)" });
```
